mapper.insert: insert into report (target_type, target_id, target_author_id, reporter_id, reason_code, detail, status, created_at) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetAuthorId}, #{reporterId}, #{reasonCode}, #{detail}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, target_type, target_id, target_author_id, reporter_id, reason_code, detail, status, handler_id, handle_action, handle_note, handle_time, created_at from report where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update report set status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_action = #{handleAction}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, handle_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.target_type as targetType, r.target_id as targetId, r.target_author_id as targetAuthorId, r.reporter_id as reporterId, ru.name as reporterName, ru.avatar as reporterAvatar, r.reason_code as reasonCode, r.detail, r.status, r.handler_id as handlerId, hu.name as handlerName, r.handle_action as handleAction, r.handle_note as handleNote, r.handle_time as handleTime, r.created_at as createdAt from report r left join user ru on ru.id = r.reporter_id left join user hu on hu.id = r.handler_id
order by r.status asc, r.created_at desc, r.id desc limit #{offset}, #{query.pageSize}
select count(*) from report where status = 0
select count(*) from report where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and status = 0
